question: What is the percentage of the population in the age group 15-64 in Bangladesh for the year 2020 as per the World Bank data?
solution:
The correct answer is __**68%.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Population ages **15-64 (% of total population)** in Bangladesh was reported at** 68% in 2020,** according to the **World Bank collection of development**__ indicators, compiled from **officially recognized sources.**
 
• Bangladesh - Population** ages 15-64 (% of total) -** actual values, historical data, forecasts and projections were sourced from the** World Bank on December of 2021.**
 
• Total population between the** ages 15 to 64 as a percentage of the total population.**
 
• Population is based on the de facto definition of population, which counts all** residents regardless of legal status or citizenship.**
